purpose: 比较重点下降品类数码两期的净销售额、退款前销售额、退款金额与订单量（金额分转元）
query: SELECT category, period, SUM(net_cents)/100.0 AS net_sales, SUM(pre_refund_cents)/100.0 AS pre_refund_sales, SUM(refund_amount_cents)/100.0 AS refund_amount, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count FROM items WHERE period IN ('control','analysis') AND category='数码' GROUP BY category, period ORDER BY period;
